_meta.anthropic/searchHint: stop end finish screen recording video capture save retrieve

description:
Stop a screen recording and retrieve its MP4. Call this even after the time limit or an early capture exit. The tool downloads recordings from remote simulators.
Returns the saved `video` and its `durationMs`. When trimming removes still sections, `wallClockMs` gives the original duration and `trimmedMs` gives the time removed. On a foldable simulator the video follows the active panel, keeps the first panel's size, and reports any `panelSwitches`.
Check `warning` for capture problems, such as an undetected foldable panel.
name: screen-recording-stop
